newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures slip in directionless trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures slip in directionless trade.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures settled lower on Thursday in directionless trade as the market received no support from the Chicago market due to Christmas holidays on Wednesday, traders said.
Prices were 20 to 190 yen lower, with the benchmark January 1998 contract down 40 yen at 14,330 yen per tonne. Daily volume was 49,416 lots.

The market started the day weaker on technical selling, but the yen's weaker tendency helped most contracts recoup some of their early losses. "Investors were wary of taking fresh positions ahead of year-end holidays," one trader said.
The CBOT Project A trading system was closed for the Christmas holiday.
